facts.fact: 四个月前七月：Logan出席发小Cece Golden（好莱坞明星）的纳什维尔生日派对
facts.anchor: Cece and I had been friends since middle school, and sometimes I still couldn’t believe that my silly, sweet friend Cecily Goldblum was now famous Hollywood starlet Cece Golden.

facts.fact: Logan溜到船屋清静，撞见兄长最恨的人Carson独坐船上
facts.anchor: It was one thing to end up at the same party as the man my brother despised; it was another to spend time alone with him.

facts.fact: 她自欺说为播客铺人脉，真相是Carson很帅、她好奇他与兄长的过节
Carson三理由：NTDP队友、播客被提过、Levi飞镖盘贴他的脸
facts.anchor: I figured you’d seen my face on your brother’s dart board.
But I’d love any insight on how to ingratiate myself with this team.

facts.fact: Logan建议：持续出现+逐个击破（Frasier问狗、Boone吃货）
facts.anchor: Frasier comes off as a grumpy bear, but if you ask him about his dogs, he’s a total softy.

facts.fact: Carson道歉时才知Logan认识Derek；Derek与Bryn大学恋人
facts.anchor: Derek and Bryn had been college sweethearts, married soon after.

facts.fact: 互相说不谈恋爱；Logan绝不与冰球运动员约会（Been there. Done that.）
facts.anchor: And if I were, I definitely wouldn’t be interested in dating a hockey player.

facts.fact: 她仍把号码给了他，定性为互利机会
facts.anchor: I wasn’t naïve enough to think that he wanted my number solely to seek my advice about his new teammates.

facts.fact: 次日晨短信：KT=Kryptonite昵称由此而来
facts.anchor: While I waited for her to respond, I changed her name in my phone to “KT.”

facts.fact: 得知她收露骨私信，Carson涌起强烈保护欲
facts.anchor: I gnashed my teeth, hit by a sudden, overwhelming surge of protectiveness.

facts.fact: 结尾：瑜伽画面引发空前吸引，他自嘲so fucked
facts.anchor: I struggled to recall a time I’d had such a powerful attraction to a woman, especially one I barely knew.
